description:
YouTube Music desktop player with built-in ad blocking and Chrome extension support

YTM Shield (YTMDesktop Adblock) is a modern YouTube Music desktop client with a built-in
Ghostery adblocker engine and unpacked Chrome extension support.

The built-in blocker uses the EasyList and uBlock Origin filter lists and injects scriptlets to
block audio/video ads and trackers between songs. Unpacked Chrome extensions such as uBlock
Origin can be loaded into the player as well.

Includes the YTM Shield Glass theme, 10-band Web Audio Equalizer & Loudness Normalization,
SponsorBlock auto-skipping, Command Palette (Ctrl+K), Miniplayer Compact Bar & Queue Drawer,
Sleep Timer across TitleBar/Miniplayer/Tray, live CSS editor, Discord Rich Presence, Last.fm
scrobbling, and Companion Server API.
YTM Shield 3.0.0:
- YTM Shield Glass native theme & ambient dynamic glow with custom accent swatches across all windows.
- 10-Band Web Audio Graphic Equalizer (32Hz–16kHz) with 6 presets and Loudness Normalization.
- SponsorBlock integration with SHA-256 prefix privacy lookup and TitleBar skip indicator.
- Global Command Palette (Ctrl+K) for instant search, queue jumping, and Shield/playback actions.
- Upgraded Miniplayer with Compact Horizontal Bar mode, Queue Drawer, Track Info, and Sleep Timer.
- Ad Shield lifetime stats, manual filter refresh, custom ABP/uBO rules, and live blocked request log.
- Unified Sleep Timer (15/30/45/60m & End of track) and enriched dynamic System Tray controls.
- Built-in live-reload CSS editor with 1-click YTM visual snippets, zero TypeScript/oxlint issues, and GitHub CI/Release workflows.
